title: M5 local Module lifecycle and deferred ecosystem decisions
goal: Record accepted D31-D32 decisions for Agent-independent immutable Module lifecycle and explicit marketplace and CODEOWNERS revisit gates.
acceptanceCriteria: V4-AD-047 records immutable local Module lifecycle operations and a read-only-first schema-driven UI scope.
Extension updates require new bundles or compositions and built-in Module updates remain Guard release changes.
V4-TODO-025 tracks local lifecycle implementation while V4-TODO-009 remains deferred behind it.
V4-TODO-016 remains conditional until a second maintainer can satisfy code-owner approval.
No product code, Module, bundle, UI, marketplace, signature, CODEOWNERS, ruleset, package or remote state changes occur.
risks: Module tooling could mutate installed authority or silently broaden capabilities.
A browser authoring surface could expand into an arbitrary source-code or command gateway.
Signatures could be mistaken for complete marketplace or Evidence execution trust.
CODEOWNERS could create an unsatisfiable repository rule while only one maintainer exists.
decisions: D31 accepts immutable Agent-independent local Module lifecycle operations and read-only-first UI scope.
D32 keeps marketplace and signature work deferred and CODEOWNERS conditional on a second maintainer.
